metadata.case_name: POON CHUNG FAI v. LEUNG KA SHING AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: comminuted closed segmental fracture of the right tibia
source: He had a comminuted closed segmental fracture of the right tibia, skin contusions and marked swelling of the right leg with some numbness.

injuries.description: right common peroneal nerve injury / peroneal nerve palsy
source: an electromyography on 4 November 1998 showed changes compatible with right common peroneal nerve injury.
There was residual weakness of the right big toe extension caused by the peroneal nerve palsy.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of peroneal nerve at lower leg level

injuries.description: cellulitis over the contused skin areas
source: The Plaintiff developed cellulitis over the contused skin areas which responded to antibiotic treatment at that time.

injuries.description: scarring of the right leg (multiple scars described)
source: He noted scarring on the leg, a 7 cm scar on the anterior aspect of the right knee; a 9 cm x 5 cm scar at the anterior aspect of the mid right leg; 2 small scars along the medial side of the right leg; 2 small scars at the superior aspect of the right leg below the knee and a 7 cm x 5 cm scar at the anterior aspect of the right leg.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

manifestations.description: marked swelling of the right leg with some numbness
residual weakness of the right big toe extension caused by the peroneal nerve palsy.
decreased dorsiflexion of the right ankle and foot
residual stiffness in the right ankle and the sub-talar joints
He was frightened to ride a motorcycle, or drive, and felt frightened when travelling as a passenger in a car.

treatments_received: closed reduction with intramedullary nailing (performed on 2 March 1998 under general anaesthesia)
removal of the locking screws (24 to 26 July 1998 under local anaesthesia)
treatments_future: removal of the intramedullary nail (recommended two years after the accident)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: no longer able to play football or swim.
embarrassed by the heavy scars on his right leg, which prevented him from wearing shorts.
walked with a limp; felt pain in his right leg after walking or standing for about 45 minutes.

difficulty in working in his previous employment as a painter and lighter jobs would be better for him; unable to take part in painting projects which involved climbing stairs, or scaffolding, or which required squatting.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: He was frightened to ride a motorcycle, or drive, and felt frightened when travelling as a passenger in a car.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Chi Shing v. Chan Kwok Engineering
comparable_cases.injury_description: Injuries regarded as just falling within the serious injury category; award increased to $460,000.00 by Court of Appeal
